entries.title: First round of US-Iran talks ends with encouraging progress, mediators say

entries.title: Despite state bans, abortions have almost doubled. The reason? Pills via telehealth
entries.snippet: States that have banned abortion are suing to stop mailing of abortion pills over state lines. But the telehealth providers say no matter the outcome, they can adapt, and so will their patients.

entries.title: Former Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan dies at 100

entries.snippet: Brexit, short for British exit, became a reality on June 23, 2016, when 52% — or more than 17 million people — voted to leave the EU. Though the margin was narrow, the vote led to the most dramatic shake-up of the U.K. economy and society since World War II.

entries.title: 75 Years of the Goethe-Institut: Germany's global cultural voice

entries.title: Ethiopia's ruling party wins overwhelming majority in parliament
